data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a positive deviation of GBP 10.9m (2013: positive deviation of GBP 5.0m); this comprises of releases GBP 8.5m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and GBP 2.4m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
Release of reserves in respect of total Reinsurance business

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year release of GBP 10.9m (net of reinsurance) driven by favourable claims development, comprised of GBP 8.5m of releases in direct Third Party Liability and GBP 2.4m of releases in reinsurance acceptances. No gross prior-year movement figure is provided in the movement note; the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 (the prior-year balance) was GBP 517.695m.
raw_causal_phrases: releases GBP 8.5m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
GBP 2.4m in respect of total Reinsurance business
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding, prior year column). The 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note reports only a NET (net of reinsurance recoveries) prior-year release of GBP 10.9m; no gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement is provided in the note. Accordingly prior_year_development_gbp_m is derived from the reported NET movement (flagged as net). No gross claims development triangle or gross prior-year movement broken down by insurance liabilities was found in the disclosed notes.
